deficiencies.description: The rewrite uses the conjunction 'since' to assert a causal link (that the terminology remains in use because surgeons can determine mobility by touch). The original text used 'where' to describe the context in which the terminology is encountered, without establishing a causal relationship.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: And you'll hear this kind of terminology even now, where a surgeon can see just by holding or touching a tumor, whether or not it's movable or immovable.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: This terminology is still heard now, since a surgeon can tell just by holding or touching a tumour whether it is movable or immovable.

considerations.sourcePassage: Okay. So with these tools in hand, I think the important concept to try and get across is invasion and metastasis.
considerations.reason: Rewritten as 'The important concepts to establish next are invasion and metastasis.' Dropping the introductory filler and converting 'concept' to the plural 'concepts' to agree with 'invasion and metastasis' is an allowed grammatical and stylistic adjustment.

considerations.sourcePassage: Obviously, changes occur within tumor cells, and it was long ago noticed back in, I don't know, when surgery was first coming into its own as a discipline after anesthesia was invented or discovered, that tumors kind of came in two types.
considerations.reason: The omission of 'Obviously', 'back in, I don't know,', and 'kind of' is permitted as dropping spoken fillers, false starts, and hedges that do not alter the factual content.
